fursona.intro1: This is nivereq, though friends often call him nivi or niver.
fursona.intro2: He is an incredibly fluffy arctic fox whose fur looks so soft it practically invites hugs.
fursona.intro3: There is nothing nivereq loves more than tight hugs. He is exceptionally gentle and friendly, and his warm aura makes everyone feel comfortable around him.
